common.tagline: Remote highland world famous for the Eye of Aldhani celestial event.
common.government: Imperial governor; pre-Imperial highland clans displaced
hyperlanes: Spur off the Hydian Way through the Cademimu sector
common.famousFor: The Eye of Aldhani — a meteor-shower spectacle every three years. Imperial payroll vault and a navigation relay.
common.cantinaReputation: Remote mountainous world in the Cademimu sector. The Empire maintains a garrison here guarding a payroll hub and a secret hyperspace navigation facility. In 15 BBY, Aldhani is lightly populated — herders and Imperial staff. The Eye of Aldhani — a spectacular celestial event — draws tourists once every three years. A risky but necessary waypoint for anyone heading to the Cademimu sector via back channels.
